title: Photo attributions
intro: Every photo used on the site and in Book 1, listed for citation. Use this when you credit images for print, Scribus export, or YouTube. Lesson images come from each lesson file; homepage photos are added by hand.
citationNote: For Creative Commons works, credit the author, note the license, and link to the source page. For Pexels, credit the photographer and Pexels. Derivative treatments (polygon paint, background removal) still require attribution of the source photo.
